request.goal: Increase full-request generated tokens per second for the interactive workload, preserving the source generation length and correctness checks.
notes: Command provenance (intent.json): python qwen_inference.py --assets /root/autodl-tmp/c3-qwen3-4b-operator-goals/assets/Qwen3-4B/1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c --output /tmp/original-qwen. The command runs all rows in the qwen_inference config; the user goal selects the interactive row (workloads.json:6-7).

Objective semantics: generated_tokens_per_second = batch * new_tokens * 1e9 / (end - start) (qwen_inference.py:40), i.e. full-request throughput over the end-to-end window including prefill/first token (README: total generation throughput counts the first token). It is not cached-only decode throughput (decode_tokens_per_second) and not TTFT.

The interactive row's declared goals (ttft_ms, decode_tokens_per_second) are the source's own goal list; the user's requested metric generated_tokens_per_second on this same row supersedes them. The source declares no performance constraints for this workload, so objective.constraints is empty.

Discrete exact comparison: greedy token IDs must match the reference exactly via torch.equal (qwen_inference.py:62, assert torch.equal(actual_tokens, tokens)); workloads.json correctness requires require_exact_greedy_tokens=true. Per-step logits (captured with fixed-context teacher forcing) are compared with torch.testing.assert_close at logits_atol=logits_rtol=0.02 (workloads.json:12, qwen_inference.py:61), and the negative control must reject a +1 corruption (common.py:negative_check).

Generation-length and stopping semantics must be preserved: the explicit loop generates exactly new_tokens=32 tokens with EOS early stopping disabled; input is the chat-templated config prompt (enable_thinking=False) repeated/truncated to prompt_tokens=256, replicated to batch=1 on cuda (qwen_inference.py:53-58).

Model config preserved: Qwen3ForCausalLM.from_pretrained(assets, dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation="sdpa").eval().cuda(); TF32 disabled, float32 matmul precision highest, cudnn.benchmark off, seed 20261020 (qwen_inference.py:49, common.py:configure).

Single-process single-GPU task (device_count=1, one leased RTX 4090): no distributed backend; the worker binds rank/device. required_observations is empty because no communication collector fields are requested; the objective is end-to-end request throughput, not diagnostic kernel time.
The user command passes no --profile, so the separate torch.profiler diagnostic (common.py:profile_once) is not part of this request.
warmup=2 and repeats=5 are the source defaults (common.py:arguments; README suite run uses the same) and are statistical harness fields, not part of the repeated work unit.

One measured invocation: One complete infer() execution in qwen_inference.py for the interactive workload: a single fixed-length greedy generation of new_tokens=32 tokens (prefill of the 256-token GPU-resident input_ids with use_cache=True and logits_to_keep=1, argmax first token, then 31 KV-cached decode steps) on batch=1 under torch.inference_mode(), bracketed by the source's CUDA-sync timing boundaries. Excludes model/tokenizer loading, chat-template tokenization, host input construction, reference generation with teacher forcing, correctness checks, statistical warmup/repeats, and profiling, which belong to the harness (qwen_inference.py:main, common.py).
